summary: An authenticated Lumen Layouts SVG floor-planning workspace where users create durable plans, place and edit fixtures, undo and redo changes, switch saved plans, export CSV summaries, and print report views.

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates, edits, saves, and reloads a floor plan

steps.action: open the workspace route while signed out
steps.expect: a platform sign-in form is visible instead of the workspace canvas

steps.action: sign in with platform email and password
steps.expect: the workspace canvas, plan sidebar, fixture library panel, inspector panel, undo control, redo control, save control, and route navigation are visible
the new plan name is shown as the active plan and an empty SVG canvas is visible
the canvas view shifts and the displayed zoom percentage changes

steps.action: drag a fixture from the library onto the canvas
steps.expect: a new fixture appears on the SVG canvas and the fixture is listed in the plan fixture list
the fixture shows a visible selected outline and the inspector shows editable position, rotation, and brightness fields

steps.action: edit the selected fixture position, rotation, and brightness
steps.expect: the fixture moves or rotates on the canvas and the displayed brightness value changes
a visible saved status with a save timestamp is shown
the signed-in workspace reloads with the saved plan name, edited fixture, fixture position, rotation, brightness, and zoom still visible

acceptance: a named plan created in the workspace remains visible after a full page reload
a fixture edited in the inspector remains in the same position with the same rotation and brightness after reload
the save status visibly changes after the user activates the save control

journeys.title: A user reverses and reapplies fixture edits

steps.expect: the active plan canvas and fixture list are visible
the selected fixture is highlighted on the canvas and its values are visible in the inspector
the fixture visibly rotates and the undo control becomes enabled
the fixture returns to its previous rotation and the redo control becomes enabled
the fixture rotation changes back to the redone value

acceptance: undo visibly restores the fixture value that was displayed before the edit
redo visibly restores the fixture value that was displayed after the edit

journeys.title: A keyboard user performs canvas actions without dragging

steps.expect: the canvas, fixture library, fixture list, and inspector are visible

steps.action: focus the fixture library with the keyboard and choose a fixture type
steps.expect: the chosen fixture type has a visible keyboard focus and selection state

steps.action: add the chosen fixture with the keyboard add control
steps.expect: a new fixture appears on the canvas and receives a visible selected outline

steps.action: nudge the selected fixture using keyboard move controls
steps.expect: the selected fixture visibly moves and the inspector position values change

steps.action: adjust canvas zoom using keyboard zoom controls
steps.expect: the displayed zoom percentage changes and focus remains visible

acceptance: a fixture can be added without mouse dragging
the selected fixture can be moved using keyboard-accessible controls
canvas zoom can be changed using keyboard-accessible controls

journeys.title: A user switches between durable saved plans

steps.expect: the plan switcher is visible
the second plan becomes active and its empty canvas is visible

steps.action: select a different plan in the plan switcher
steps.expect: the selected plan name becomes active and that plan's saved fixtures are shown

steps.action: switch back to the second plan
steps.expect: the second plan name becomes active and its own canvas state is shown

acceptance: each plan selection shows the selected plan name
fixtures from one plan are not shown as fixtures belonging to another plan

journeys.title: A user reviews the fixture library route

steps.expect: the Lumen Layouts fixture library page is visible
lighting fixtures such as ceiling light and wall sconce are visible

acceptance: the library route shows reusable fixture types
choosing the Lighting category visibly filters the fixture list

journeys.title: A user exports and prints a plan summary

steps.expect: the reports page shows a plan selector and summary preview area

steps.action: select a saved plan for reporting
steps.expect: the summary preview shows the selected plan name and a table of fixture counts and brightness values
a downloadable CSV file is produced with the selected plan name and fixture summary rows
a print-ready summary view is visible and a print requested status message is shown

acceptance: the exported file contains the selected plan name
the exported file contains fixture summary rows
printing shows a print-ready summary for the selected plan

journeys.title: A signed-in user views settings and account ownership boundaries

steps.expect: the settings page shows the signed-in account email and sign-out control
the signed-out state is visible and workspace navigation requires sign-in again

acceptance: settings shows the current signed-in account email
after sign-out the workspace is not visible until sign-in

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: public Lumen Layouts landing page with navigation to sign in and enter the workspace

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: authenticated SVG canvas for creating, editing, saving, undoing, redoing, panning, zooming, and switching floor plans

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: authenticated fixture library reference with visible categories and reusable fixture types

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: authenticated plan summary preview with export and print controls

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: authenticated account settings page showing the signed-in user and sign-out control

entities.name: plan
relationships: a plan belongs to one signed-in user

entities.name: fixture
relationships: a fixture belongs to one plan

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: a signed-out visitor can view the public home route but cannot see workspace, library, reports, or settings content
a signed-in user can only see and modify plans and fixtures they own
signing out hides the workspace and requires platform sign-in before protected routes are visible again

operations.description: create a durable user-owned floor plan via db.entity('plan').create

responsibilities.behavior: initialize a new plan with a generated id, default viewport, empty selection, and empty undo and redo stacks

operations.description: list the signed-in user's plans via db.entity('plan').list
load one user-owned plan and its fixtures for display
persist pan and zoom values on the active plan via db.entity('plan').update
store the active fixture selection for the current plan
create a durable fixture from a library fixture type via db.entity('fixture').create

responsibilities.behavior: derive a new fixture id, category, label, initial canvas coordinates, zero rotation, and full brightness from the chosen fixture type and active plan

operations.description: persist edited fixture position, rotation, and brightness via db.entity('fixture').update
apply the previous fixture value from the in-session undo history and persist the restored fixture fields

responsibilities.behavior: restore the selected fixture's previous position, rotation, or brightness from undo history

operations.description: reapply the next fixture value from the in-session redo history and persist the restored fixture fields

responsibilities.behavior: reapply the selected fixture's next position, rotation, or brightness from redo history

operations.description: mark the active plan as saved and persist the visible save timestamp via db.entity('plan').update

responsibilities.behavior: generate a visible save timestamp for the active plan

operations.description: export a CSV summary for the selected plan and its fixtures

responsibilities.behavior: produce a downloadable CSV summary containing the plan name, fixture labels, fixture types, positions, rotations, and brightness values

operations.description: show a print-ready summary and request browser printing

responsibilities.behavior: render a print-ready plan summary view containing the plan name and fixture table and set a visible print requested status

states.validation: email and password are required by the platform sign-in form

states.empty: no plans yet; create your first plan
states.validation: plan name is required before creating a plan
states.error: plan could not be saved, try again
states.success: saved status with timestamp is visible

states.empty: the active plan has no fixtures yet
states.validation: zoom must remain within the visible minimum and maximum zoom controls
states.error: canvas change could not be applied
states.success: fixture selection outline and updated canvas values are visible

states.empty: choose a saved plan to preview a report
states.validation: a plan must be selected before export or print
states.success: summary preview, export result, or print-ready view is visible
account email and sign-out control are visible

acceptance.statement: a signed-out visitor opening /workspace sees a sign-in form instead of the SVG floor-planning workspace
a submitted plan name is shown as the active plan after creation
a placed fixture appears on the SVG canvas and in the fixture list
an edited fixture position, rotation, and brightness are still visible after a full page reload
undo and redo controls visibly change the selected fixture back and forward between edited values
keyboard controls can add a fixture, move it, and change canvas zoom without mouse dragging
switching plans shows the selected plan's own name and fixtures
exporting a plan summary produces a downloadable CSV containing the selected plan name
printing a plan summary shows a print-ready view and a visible print requested status
after signing out from settings, opening /workspace shows the sign-in form instead of saved plans

deferred.item: collaborative multi-user editing in the same plan
deferred.reason: the request requires user-owned durable plans but does not require real-time collaboration
the request asks for dragging fixtures from a library, not uploading new fixture artwork
the request requires export and print; a browser-downloadable CSV summary and print-ready browser view satisfy those observable outputs without an external integration
